patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with a large, dynamic background graphic and a prominent, multi-line heading.
Headings combine a bold, modern sans-serif with an elegant, italicized script font for key phrases, creating visual contrast and emphasis.
A high-contrast palette of dark charcoal and off-white is consistently used for alternating section backgrounds, with a vibrant lime green as a primary accent.
Background elements in the hero section, such as the large leaf graphic and geometric shapes, parallax at a slower rate than the foreground content as the user scrolls.
The top navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background with a subtle shadow after the initial hero section.
Feature sections often use a two-column layout with a large image or graphic on one side and descriptive text with bullet points or statistics on the other.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation that dynamically changes its size and background appearance (from transparent to solid white) as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Background elements in the hero and other sections utilize a parallax scrolling effect, moving at a different speed than the foreground content to add depth.

Content sections and individual elements are revealed with scroll-triggered animations, likely involving staggered fade-ins or slide-ups as they enter the viewport, leveraging GSAP and Locomotive Scroll for smooth transitions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are frequently paired with an elegant, italicized script font for emphasis, while body text is a clean, legible sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons and cards have a slight, consistent corner rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous vertical and horizontal spacing creates a sense of openness, particularly in the hero and between major sections, with balanced density in content grids.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the sophisticated typographic pairing of a bold, modern sans-serif with an elegant, italicized script font for key phrases within headings. This, combined with the dynamic parallax effects and high-contrast color palette, elevates the site beyond a typical agency template.
